artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{P}$ denote the positive integers. A graded poset $P = \bigsqcup_{n \ge 0} P_n$ with $|P_0|=1$ is called an $r$-differential poset (for $r \in \mathbb{P}$) if it is locally finite, has a unique minimum element, and satisfies the following two conditions:
(D1) If $x \neq y$ are elements of $P$, then the number of elements covering both $x$ and $y$ equals the number of elements covered by both $x$ and $y$.
(D2) For every $x \in P$, if $x$ covers exactly $k$ elements, then $x$ is covered by exactly $k+r$ elements.

Two basic examples are Young's lattice $Y$ (the lattice of integer partitions ordered by inclusion of Young diagrams), which is $1$-differential, and its $r$-fold Cartesian product $Y^{\times r}$, which is $r$-differential.

Fix $r \in \mathbb{P}$ and $n \ge 0$. Determine the minimum value of $|P_n|$ as $P$ ranges over all $r$-differential posets. In particular, decide whether this minimum is attained by $P = Y^{\times r}$.
artifact.status_search_result: Stanley's 1988 conjecture posits that the rank sizes of any r-differential poset lie between those of Y^{×r} (lower bound) and the Young–Fibonacci lattice YF_r (upper bound). The upper bound was established by Byrnes (2012). The lower bound — equivalently, the question of the minimum rank size — remains open. Miller (2013) proved strict rank growth as a partial result, and various consequences have been verified for Y^{×r}, but the conjectured minimum has not been proved.

status_evidence.title: Differential Posets have Strict Rank Growth: A Conjecture of Stanley
status_evidence.snippet: Stanley conjectured rank sizes lie between Young's lattice and Young–Fibonacci lattice; strict rank growth proved.
status_evidence.claim: The lower-bound conjecture (minimum at Y^{×r}) is still open; only partial results (e.g., strict rank growth) are known.

status_evidence.title: On the rank function of a differential poset (arXiv:1111.4371)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies rank function growth of differential posets, giving non-polynomial lower bounds approaching Hardy–Ramanujan.
status_evidence.claim: Only asymptotic/lower bounds on growth are known, not the exact minimum conjectured by Stanley.

status_evidence.title: Differential poset - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of Stanley's conjectures on rank sizes between Y^{×r} and YF_r.
status_evidence.claim: The minimum rank-size problem remains an open conjecture.
